title: Light Slovakian Cauliflower Skillet
description: A low-calorie, jammy, and gooey Slovakian dish featuring cauliflower, cooked to perfection in an iron teppan skillet. This recipe is a healthier take on traditional Slovakian cuisine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the iron teppan skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the cauliflower florets to the skillet and cook until they are tender, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for one minute.
Reduce heat to low and stir in the low-fat sour cream, cooking until the sauce is heated through and the cauliflower is coated.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Poach eggs on top of the skillet if desired, for added protein and creaminess.
